title: Umceli weNdawo Engcwele
intro: Ngeeyure ezizolileyo zobusuku, umphefumlo ozinikeleyo wabiza uSozinceba ngaphakathi kweendonga ezingcwele zendawo engcwele. Iminyaka yokholo olungagungqiyo nomonde yayiza kuvuzwa ngommangaliso owawuza kuzisa uvuyo kunye nelifa lobuprofeti.
clues: Ndichithe imini nobusuku bam ndizinikele kwindawo engcwele engcwele, ndithandaza rhoqo eNkosini yam.
Ndaluphala, umfazi wam wayengenabantwana, kodwa andizange ndilahle ithemba kwinceba ka-Allah.
Ndanikwa unyana, ogama linguYahya, owaba ngumprofeti nesibane sobulungisa.
Nam ndandingumprofeti, ndithunywe ukukhokela abantwana bakwaSirayeli.
Ndandingumzukulwana woMprofeti uHarun kwaye ndandingumbingeleli eTempile.
Ndaphathiswa umsebenzi wokunyamekela uMaryam, unina ka-Isa, ndaza ndayibona imimangaliso yakhe.
